+    if endpoint is None:
+        return {}

+        if isinstance(endpoint, functools.partial):
+            endpoint = endpoint.func
+        if not inspect.isfunction(endpoint) and not inspect.ismethod(endpoint):
+            endpoint = endpoint.__call__
+        code = endpoint.__code__
+        return {
+            "file": code.co_filename,
+            "line": code.co_firstlineno,
+            "function": endpoint.__name__,
+        }
+    except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError):
+        return {}
